Normalized Power divided by average heart rate, power-to-heart-rate drift, and average power at a heart rate in your Karoo heart-rate zone 2. Drift compares the power-to-heart-rate ratio of both ride halves after 20 minutes of paired data.
kEtape keeps saved values if it can verify the same account. Otherwise it clears them.
Alerts use your saved Intervals.icu benchmarks. Connect an account to use them.

NP/HR divides the Karoo’s normalized power by its average heart rate. Z2♥ is the average power while your heart rate is in Karoo zone 2. It includes measured zero watts.

Drift compares the ratio of average watts to average heart rate in the first and second halves of the paired data. Both power and heart rate must be present for at least 20 minutes in total, excluding recording pauses. A positive drift means you produced fewer watts per beat per minute in the second half. Compare rides with similar conditions and a steady effort.

A dash means more data is needed or a reading is unavailable. After kEtape restarts during a ride, Drift and Z2♥ return on the next complete ride.
